says: Comments are thin here. Under the 1,274× serum video, people trade how often to apply it and purging tips, some say it made their skin worse, and skeptics say no serum beats a laser. The loudest signal is two New York women posting their own videos begging for an NYC acne dermatologist who "really cares" after Accutane and years of spironolactone stopped working. Run 1's viewer questions add the same worries: what if your skin scars easily, does this work on brown skin prone to hyperpigmentation, and what if everything except water breaks you out.
